name: España – tarifa 2.0TD (potencia contratada P1/P2)
assumed: Nothing about the rule: 2.0TD's two power periods are Circular 3/2020 art. 7.4 as amended by Circular 1/2025 – punta-llano on working weekdays 08–24, valle the rest plus Saturdays, Sundays, 6 January and national holidays. The contracted kW per period is the household's own contract and is asked; the interruptor trips at the contract, with no tolerance assumed.
